About

I am a senior at Olentangy Orange High School in Lewis Center, Ohio, and a dual-enrollment student at The Ohio State University and Columbus State Community College. My interests lie at the intersection of biology, medicine, and computation, and I hope to pursue a career in medicine and research.

Outside of academics, I enjoy weightlifting, running, playing basketball, and cooking.

3

Projects

SCENT

A low-cost electronic nose that identifies 9 chemical vapors with 90% accuracy (99% with humidity sensing). Built toward breath-based screening. 1st place at the OSU Makeathon.

View on GitHub →

Mec-tx Tumor Optimization

A tool that groups cancer patients by the timing of their treatments, built with the Spakowicz Lab at Ohio State.

Diabetic Retinopathy Data Leakage Audit

A check of published AI models for diabetic eye disease, testing how duplicate images in their data affect the results.

CPR Confidence Study

A survey of 379 Central Ohio high school students on how prepared they feel to perform CPR.

Chromatin Accessibility Divergence

A statistical test for whether open chromatin explains why CRISPR knockdowns affect some cell lines more than others. It held false positives near 5% (under 8% in the worst case), where standard tests reached up to 26%.

View on GitHub →

WWTP Compliance Failure Prediction

A model that predicts which wastewater plants are likely to break pollution limits. Stockholm Junior Water Prize Ohio winner.

Ooty Kannada Dictionary

An online dictionary of Ooty Kannada, my family's dialect, which has no written script of its own.

View the dictionary →
